summary: Re-review after 2 fix commits resolving all 6 prior fix_tasks: clock-derived date, Err-vs-None abort, missing tests added, English renames fixed. No new defects. Approve.
notes: contract-check ok=true, 0 violations; not_checked: forbid.behaviors (reviewed by hand below). acceptance-coverage: status=pass, 0 gaps, all AC-1..AC-9 covered (AC-1/2/3/5 correctly deferred to HEX-057-a's pre-existing tests per the spec's scope fence). 05-validation.json: 27/27 verify.commands exit 0, overall passed.

Limits verified independently: 17 files changed, 1889 insertions / 25 deletions vs main. Per-class: storage/src ~660/800, storage/tests 881/900 (widened 850->900 by dated human decision recorded in 02-contract.yaml, not a violation), hexcell/src 40/130, hexcell/tests 196/200, docs 67/280. All touched files are within the task's touch list.

DEFECT 1 RESOLUTION VERIFIED (hardcoded marker date): reversion.rs:39-70 now derives fecha_absoluta_de_hoy() from crate::tiempo::a_milisegundos(SystemTime::now()) plus a hand-rolled Howard Hinnant civil_from_days conversion (fecha_civil_desde_dias_desde_epoch, reversion.rs:51-70). Manually dry-ran the algorithm for dias=0 and it correctly resolves to 1970-01-01; era/doe/yoe arithmetic matches the canonical reference transcription term-for-term. a_milisegundos saturates at 0 for pre-epoch instants (tiempo.rs) so div_euclid never sees a negative dividend in practice. The test at tests/reversion.rs:558-567 was correctly loosened to assert ISO shape (YYYY-MM-DD, all-digit parts) instead of the old literal, so it will not falsely fail as dates roll forward.

DEFECT 2 RESOLUTION VERIFIED (Err collapsed into None): reversion.rs:320-329 now reads numero_anterior via con_lectura(...).map_err(...) propagated with `?` (no more .ok().flatten()), with a comment at lines 312-319 explaining the distinction between the legitimate Ok(None) (initial base epoch) and a genuine read Err. This abort happens BEFORE nuevo_pool is opened (line 334) and BEFORE the marker is written or the symlink reassigned (lines 340-352), so no partial state (no open pool, no half-written marker, no touched symlink) is left on the error path. Isolated by the new dedicated test verificar_guarda_reversion_aborta_ante_error_de_lectura_de_numero_anterior (tests/reversion.rs:618-644), which forces a REAL SQLite error via DROP TABLE metadatos_de_epoca from a second connection on the outgoing epoch's file (not the Ok(None) NULL-row case), then asserts the reversion errors, no .sospechosa marker exists, and the symlink still points at the outgoing epoch.

DEFECT 3 RESOLUTION VERIFIED (English identifiers): grep for standalone 'guard' (word-boundary, excluding guarda/guardia/guardian) across crates/hexcell-storage/{src,tests} and crates/hexcell/{src,tests} returns only 'GUARD-N' labels, which are the spec's own vocabulary (00-spec.yaml itself uses GUARD-1..GUARD-12 as invariant tags) used inside Spanish-language comments as cross-reference tags, not English test-function or variable names. All 12 test functions are now verificar_guarda_N_* and pools.rs uses 'guardia' locals consistent with its pre-existing 'guardianes' naming. No leftover verificar_guard_ function names.

MISSING TESTS RESOLVED: acceptance-coverage confirms AC-4 COMPUESTA (composite scenario: viva + superseida-sin-drenar + dentro-de-ventana + marcada + two purge candidates in one pass) exists in tests/retencion.rs; async orchestration tests for ventana_de_retencion_de_epocas_desde_entorno (valid/non-numeric/negative/absent), purgar_epocas_de_conocimiento end-to-end, and drenar_epoca_superseida_de_conocimiento's registry-retirement side effect exist in crates/hexcell/tests/promocion.rs (+192 lines); GUARD-9's failure half is covered by verificar_guarda_9_fallo_de_escritura_de_marca_aborta_con_produccion_intacta (tests/reversion.rs:576-608), which occupies the marker's file path with a directory to force a real std::fs::write I/O error and asserts abort with symlink and pool intact.

Four never-purge invariants confirmed enforced IN CODE, not only by tests, reading the current retencion.rs: (1) live epoch - es_viva branch (retencion.rs:373-374, 403) always conserved first, by canonical-path OR intrinsic-number match; (2) undrained superseded - en_uso.contains_key checked before window eligibility (retencion.rs ~409); (3) reversion target - structurally impossible to race because purgar_epocas_retiradas and revertir_a_epoca both open with gestor.iniciar_promocion(), a mutex-backed exclusion; (4) retention window - computed over candidatos_sanos_no_vivos with marked epochs explicitly excluded from window eligibility (so a defect-suspect epoch gets no recency protection, per spec). The classification is a strict if/else-if chain per candidate, so a file only reaches the deletion branch after failing all four conservation checks in sequence -- no short-circuit lets one invariant mask another. No TOCTOU risk beyond single-process: all file removal happens while iniciar_promocion() holds exclusivity, and sealed epoch files are never written to except by promotion/reversion, both gated by the same mutex.

AC-6 EXCEPTION (section C) verified honestly documented: the comment at retencion.rs:363-372, directly above the es_viva OR, cites the exact constraint by file and line (migraciones/conocimiento/0002-esquema-de-conocimiento.sql:103, CHECK ((numero_de_epoca IS NULL) = (sellada_ms IS NULL)) - confirmed to match the actual migration file), explains WHY the canonical-path arm is unfalsifiable in isolation today (the CHECK constraint couples the two columns so the one file whose canonical path matches the live path necessarily also matches on intrinsic number), and states the retention rationale (defense-in-depth against a future migration decoupling that identity). No fake/trivially-passing test was added for the canonical arm; instead, a genuine new test (verificar_es_viva_brazo_numerico_protege_duplicado_con_ruta_distinta, tests/retencion.rs:507-552) constructs a real corrupted-duplicate scenario that DOES mutation-provably isolate the numeric arm, which is honest engineering, not a decorative substitute.

Purge remains the sole deletion path: grepped for remove_file/remove_dir/set_len across reversion.rs, drenaje.rs, pools.rs, error.rs and crates/hexcell/src/promocion.rs - none found; promocion.rs keeps exactly one pre-existing remove_file (stale-symlink cleanup). No evidence this task's deletion capability generalizes: escribir_marca_de_epoca_sospechosa only writes, never deletes; the registry (epocas_en_uso) and ConstanciaDeDrenaje (private fields, pub(crate) nueva, Debug+PartialEq only, no Clone/Copy/Default/serde) remain the sole non-forgeable removal gate for that map.

Architectural invariants verified: hexcell-core dependency table empty (adr-0002), no rusqlite in crates/hexcell (adr-0010), rusqlite still pinned 0.39, hexcell-storage remains executor-free (no tokio/async fn/.await/spawn_blocking), no Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock changes, no new runtime dependencies. Docs: adr-0027 correctly extends adr-0006 and adr-0026 without rewriting them; docs/adr/README.md row added; D-32 in bitacora-de-descartes.md is correlative after D-31, records the rejected marker-after-switchover ordering, never edits prior entries; docs/STATUS.md records both the definitive retention-window value AND the marker-clearing operator surface as PENDING declared decisions, same treatment as the dedup window precedent. All dates absolute (2026-08-31/2026-08-27), no relative-date leaks found by grep. No *.db/.env versioned, no secrets observed.

The canonicalize constraint from 00-spec.yaml line 30 remains correctly undisturbed: promocion.rs still uses map_err into ArchivoDeEpocaInaccesible with no unwrap_or; this diff's fix commits do not touch that expression, consistent with it being already discharged by HEX-057-a.
